description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.
Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by stakeholders.
Cybersecurity roles responsibilities and authorities are established and communicated.
Physical devices and systems are inventoried.
Software platforms and applications are inventoried.
Vulnerabilities in assets are identified and documented.
Identities and credentials are managed for authorized users services and hardware.
Configuration management practices are established and applied.
Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed after a cybersecurity incident.
